name: Ediction
source:
Raised from the dead, a man whose life was riddled with pain is made to consider what his last words will be once again.

[From [url=https://donattico.itch.io/ediction]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个生命充满痛苦的人从死里复活，被迫再次思考他的遗言是什么。

[来自[url=https://donattico.itch.io/ediction]itch.io[/url]]
